items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:28:1
items.html: The Hesed of Atik Yomin — they have no attainment whatsoever, by any possibility: For the Hesed of Atik clothes in the Keter of AA, which is concealed like the Radla [the unknown head] itself, as explained above, page 694, Part 8, Inner Observation, item 9, the passage beginning “And ZA.” For it is reckoned as a root only for the discernment of the Hesed of AA, and nothing at all for the other Mochin, and all the more so for ZA. See there. There is no need to elaborate.
